welcome.title: Hi! 👋 I'm your guide
welcome.body: I'll help you set up MarketMate in a few steps. You can skip anytime (top right) and resume later from Settings.

identita.title: Start with yourself 🏪
identita.body: Enter your business name and your name. They'll save automatically.

logistica.title: Your logistics 🚚
logistica.body: Where do you start each day and what vehicle do you use? Used to calculate km and fuel cost.

agenda_setup.title: Your markets 📅
agenda_setup.body: Open the Agenda and add markets for each day of the week (name, city, km, pitch fee). You can also do this later. Tap "Open Settings", AGENDA section.

fornitori_setup.title: Your suppliers 🚛
fornitori_setup.body: Add the suppliers you buy from (e.g. Bread Andrea, Dairy Rossi). You can also do this later. Go to Settings, SUPPLIERS section.

collab_setup.title: Collaborators 👥
collab_setup.body: Have helpers? Just add their names (e.g. Sara, Paolo). You'll add fees and other data later. Open Settings, COLLABORATORS section.

spese_fisse_setup.title: Fixed expenses 💸
spese_fisse_setup.body: Pitch fees → enter them in the market card itself (in Agenda). Other annual expenses (van insurance, social security, accountant, etc.) go in Settings → ANNUAL EXPENSES. The app spreads them across working days automatically.

home_calendar.title: Browse days 📆
home_calendar.body: On the Home screen at the top you see the date. Use the ◀ ▶ arrows to move forward/back one day, or tap the date to open the full calendar.

home_lordo.title: Today's weather ☀️
home_lordo.body: The app preselects the weather based on real forecasts. You can always change it manually by tapping the matching icon (sun, cloud, rain...).

home_incasso.title: How much did you earn today? 💰
home_incasso.body: Enter the GROSS total, then split: how much in CASH and how much by CARD. Cash + Card must match Gross.

spese_extra_voci.title: Today's extra expenses 🛒
spese_extra_voci.body: Enter all expenses today: from suppliers (you'll see the names from Settings) to anything else (coffee, lunch, parking, tolls, etc.). For suppliers you can choose cash or invoice, and split the cost over multiple days.

home_salva.title: Save the day 💾
home_salva.body: When ready, tap SAVE to archive the day. You'll find it in history, charts and statistics.

stats.title: Your statistics 📊
stats.body: In Statistics you see gross/net charts, top markets, top suppliers, pie charts and many other useful insights.

buongiorno.title: The «Good Morning» AI 🤖
buongiorno.body: Every morning open Good Morning to get weather, upcoming deadlines, cheapest fuel prices and personalized tips based on YOUR data.

carburante_setup.title: Fuel consumption ⛽
carburante_setup.body: In Settings → FUEL you can enter the last refuel (liters & euros). The app will automatically calculate how much each market costs based on km driven.

notes_setup.title: Your agenda 📝
notes_setup.body: In NOTES you can write appointments, orders to suppliers, deadlines, ideas. Everything here will also appear in the Home calendar and notification bell. Try it now!

backup_info.title: Data backup 💾
backup_info.body: Always export a backup! Go to Settings → DATA BACKUP and tap EXPORT to save a file. Send it via WhatsApp, email or load it later if you change phone.

done.title: 🎉 All set!
done.body: You're ready to start! Remember: you can relaunch this guide anytime from Settings → RESTART GUIDE. Good luck!
